Noah: hi team 👋 I'm Noah, starting as AE Monday. Quick list: HubSpot access, Gong, Dialpad softphone, demo laptop image, and where the latest playbook + 1-pager/battlecard live. Also any email template bank for outreach? who should i ping for each? thanks!
Onboarding Bot: welcome @Noah! 🎉 Provision ticket: https://redwood.in/onboard/Noah. Fill the form and you'll get auto-added to #sales-onboarding.
Rosa (sales-ops): hey @Noah — i'll own HubSpot + Gong + Dialpad. Fill the form and include your preferred alias and caller ID. Typical turnaround same-day. For email templates we have a shared repo (see marketing-tools below).
Noah: form submitted. alias noah@redwood.com. Caller ID = "Redwood - Noah"
Rosa (sales-ops): got it — HubSpot seat queued, Gong invite sent, Dialpad softphone request logged. I'll post updates here if anything needs approval.
Ming (IT): For the demo laptop — mac-arm or ubuntu-22? We image and MDM-enroll. After image run VPN + bootstrap:```
curl -fsSL https://dl.redwood/bootstrap.sh | sudo bash
```
Which OS do you want?
Noah: mac-arm please.
Ming (IT): starting image build now, ETA ~3 hours. You'll receive an email when the image is ready with temporary creds. If you need Dialpad before the account is fully provisioned, download the app and we'll push credentials when ready.
Sam (AE-buddy): welcome @Noah! i'll DM you the "week1" checklist, 3 sample call recordings, and the shadow calendar. I also keep a short objection cheat sheet and a 1-page product battlecard — will add to the Drive link. Free to shadow Tue 11am.
Iris (marketing-tools): @Noah i'll add you to the email template repo and the one-pager folder: https://drive.redwood/sales/collateral. Templates include: prospect intro, pricing explainers, and trial follow-up. If you want a tailored slide, DM me company logo + vertical and i'll assemble.
Noah: perfect — one more: where's the Loom consent phrasing and recording policy?
Rosa (sales-ops): consent language and recording policy are in the onboarding checklist and the "Demo checklist" module in Learning. Loom access is provisioned by Tools; @Iris just granted you access.
Iris (marketing-tools): added you to the template repo and demo folder. You should get invites in < 30 min. Also dropping a quick email snippet you can copy: "Quick intro — I'm Noah from Redwood Inference. Can I grab 20 minutes to show a short walkthrough tailored to your stack?"
Noah: thanks everyone — super helpful. excited to start! :rocket:
